entries.zh: 揪住头发抢夺（抓住头发把人拖拽过来）
entries.en: To seize someone by the hair and drag them off
entries.notes: H「綜来」字面难通，释义依 L「arrebatar del cabello」与 M/R 对音推定。

entries.en: They snatch; they seize
They snatch away the mallet or club (the curved stick)
entries.notes: L 后半「quelean y purpian ltos ello」残损难辨，仅取「palo curvo」与 H「夺搥」为据。

entries.en: To snatch away the belt or sash
entries.notes: L 后半「gpar seanello」难辨，释义依 H「夺带」定夺。

entries.en: To snatch them away and bring them here

entries.zh: 抢了去；夺走（拿到别处去）
entries.en: To snatch away and take off elsewhere
entries.notes: L 末尾「mete -」截断，R 栏两音节 T99 污损难辨，仅 H「夺去哪」可据。

entries.en: To snatch them and run off
They rob; to seize by force
To rob a person and strip him of his clothes
They snatch; to plunder

entries.zh: 抢夺并驱散（抢了使人四散逃开）
entries.en: To snatch and scatter people in all directions
entries.notes: L「y anparun」难辨，疑为「y esparcen」，与 H「搶四散」相合。

entries.en: To snatch and run away

entries.zh: 抢购便宜货；趁价贱抢买
entries.en: To snap up goods at a cheap price; to buy up a bargain

entries.zh: 抢钱虎（喻贪暴搜刮钱财的人）
entries.en: A 'money-snatching tiger' — a rapacious grabber of money
entries.notes: L 后半「trajandola como vintige」难辨，释义依 H「搶錢虎」定夺。

entries.en: To snatch; to steal, as a thief does
To carry off a woman to marry her; marriage by capture
entries.notes: L「aonsla」难辨，疑为「a una」；H「搶嫁」义明，据此定夺。

entries.en: To snatch away and take it for oneself
To snatch and strip bare; to plunder
entries.notes: L「los coja lo envelas nagnus」残损难辨，释义依 H「搶剥」定夺。

entries.en: They seize by force; to occupy

entries.zh: 占位；夺去他人的位置或职位
entries.en: To take another's place or office
To occupy a place; to take up a spot
entries.notes: L「qui talbell yan」难辨，释义依 H「占處」定夺。

entries.en: To strip; to despoil
To strip and rob; to plunder
entries.notes: L「nabatina」难辨，释义依 H「剥劫」定夺。

entries.en: To waylay and rob someone of silver
